name: rti-online-redesign
description: Full-stack RTI Online prototype with a React frontend, Express API, and MongoDB Atlas database.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm --prefix frontend run api:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
